title: 花旗杨霭仪：腾讯现金流波动只是时点问题，无需融资
speaker: Alicia Yapp

segments.en: Is it concerning that they're basically trading free cash for negative at a time when that pathway to monetization on these AI investments is still maybe not as clear or do you see it a bit differently?
segments.zh: 在AI投入变现路径尚不明朗时，自由现金流转为负值，您是否担忧？还是您有不同的看法？

segments.en: This is only one quarter, but if you look at the operating profit, they're able to generate.
segments.zh: 这只是一个季度，但要看他们能产生的营业利润。

segments.en: So it's actually over 300 billion, full year, on the full year basis.
So sometimes it's just a one quarter impact because they have to prepay.
segments.zh: 所以有时只是单季度影响，因为他们需要预付款。

segments.en: So for example, if you wanted to sign certain contracts and your customer asked you to prepay, you have to prepay to secure.
segments.zh: 例如，如果要签合同，客户要求预付款，你就得预付以确保。

segments.en: So I actually think it's just a timing of some of the outflow.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这只是部分流出的时点问题。

segments.en: But on the full year basis, there are core businesses still generating decent operating cash flow.
segments.zh: 但全年来看，核心业务仍能产生可观的经营现金流。

segments.en: So no need to raise money.
We obviously don't know what they're thinking about it.
segments.zh: 我们显然不知道他们怎么想。

segments.en: But if they want, they can tap into the debt market and not that. And then they also have the investment portfolio that they can also sell down if they really need it.
segments.zh: 但如果需要，他们可以进入债务市场，而且他们还有投资组合，必要时可以出售。
